C + D, merged.

C gives the structure: sheet header, figure numbers, the discipline table, the revision block, the title-block footer. D gives the dark ground and the gold accent.

A dark blueprint is also historically honest — drawings really were light lines on a dark field.

Colours and graphics are placeholders per your note. The line art is drawn, not final.

Needs you to confirm:

1. Current role — your CV ends at Trunovate 2025, but your project files show you running IT and the 3D pipeline at a playground/arch-viz studio. Marked [STUDIO NAME] and [CONFIRM] in the revision table.

2. [N] products in the 3D library.

3. Phone number is on the page — say if you'd rather it weren't public.

Not built yet — tell me which you want:

· A case-study page for the packing solver (your strongest single story)
· A 3D / arch-viz gallery page
· An about page
· Mobile width for this home page
· Hebrew / RTL version
